notes.title: Enter the unknown world of Backrooms Level X on May 29th!
notes.content:
We're really excited to announce that you can experience the chilling world of Backrooms Level X starting May 29th! This first-person survival horror game inspired by the legendary Backrooms universe is coming later this month to Steam, and we're celebrating it with a new trailer. Explore endless liminal spaces, solve challenging puzzles, and face terrifying entities and giant bosses in a unique, atmospheric adventure!

[previewyoutube=GDbznowp3mk;full][/previewyoutube]

In case you're not familiar with Backrooms Level X yet, here are some of the things that await you in this intriguing universe:
[list]
[*] 13 levels filled with horror and mystery.
[*] Immersive exploration and narrative-driven gameplay.
[*] Challenging puzzles and environments.
[*] Atmospheric graphics and haunting sound design.
[/list]
Are you ready to confront your deepest fears and uncover the secrets of the Backrooms?
Add Backrooms Level X to your wishlist and prepare for its release on May 29th! And don't forget to follow us on social media ([url=https://x.com/FirenutGames]Twitter/X[/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/firenutgames.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url]) and to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/qsCzxnFCuF]Discord[/url] server to stay up to date with all the news, since the game will also be available on PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch at a later date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303230/Backrooms_Level_X/
